steps.title: Free pieces
steps.body: An undefended piece is one that nothing can recapture on. If it is attacked, it is a free gift. Learn to scan for them every move, yours and theirs.

wrong.default: Which black piece has no defender?

steps.onSuccess: The bishop had no defender, so the rook took it for free.

wrong.default: Now it is your piece that is attacked. Can you win something instead?

steps.onSuccess: The knight was undefended, so Rxd4 won it.

steps.q: Which piece is easiest to win?

solution: A piece nothing can recapture on.
